title: depengine schema.toml
description: JSON Schema for depengine schema.toml — validates structure, method kinds, and required fields for distro-agnostic dependency installation files.

manager.description: Default manager when a tool doesn't specify anything.

aur_helper.description: AUR helper to use for aur method. Only relevant on Arch-based distros.

method_order.description: Order in which methods are tried when a tool declares multiple candidates. Stops at the first that succeeds.

tools.title: Tool declarations
tools.description: Every key under [tools] is either the special 'simple' list or a tool declaration.

simple.description: List of simple tool names. These tools use the default manager (native) and the package name equals the tool name.

stringTool.description: Tool whose native package name equals the tool name. Shorthand for { native = "<tool-name>" }.

inlineTool.title: Tool declaration (inline or full block)
inlineTool.description: A tool declared as an inline table ({ apt = "fd-find" }) or a full block ([tools.X] + [tools.X.method]).

requires.description: List of tool names this tool depends on (installed first).

pre_install.description: Pre-install hook that runs before any method is attempted. Runs via shell.

postinstall.description: Post-install command that runs after any method succeeds (e.g. fc-cache, systemctl daemon-reload).

tags.description: Tags for profile filtering (e.g. desktop, server, fonts).

method_prefer.description: Methods to try first, before the defaults. Example: ['cargo'] tries cargo before native.

method_only.description: Exhaustive list — only these methods are tried, in this order. Global method_order is ignored.

oneOf.description: Package/module name for this method. Shorthand for { pkg = "<name>" }.

methodObject.title: Method configuration
methodObject.description: Configuration for one installation method. Can include method-specific fields plus an optional 'when' condition.

pkg.description: Package/module/binary name to install via this method.

kind.description: Override the adapter dispatch key. When the section key differs from the adapter kind (e.g. "http-musl" is a variant of "http"), set kind = "<adapter>" so the method resolves to the correct adapter.

git.description: Git repository URL (for cargo install --git, go install, etc.).

url.description: Download URL. Supports {latest} placeholder for GitHub release tags.

build.description: Build command executed inside the cloned repository (run via shell). Used by git adapter.

checksum.description: Checksum for verification. "sha256:auto" = calculate on first download (TOFU). "sha256:<hex>" = pinned verification.

checksum_url.description: Explicit URL for the checksum file. Overrides auto URL patterns when checksum is :auto.

checksum_file_format.description: Format of the checksum file: 'sha256sum' (default), 'bsd' (BSD-style), or 'raw' (file content is the hash).

signature_url.description: URL to GPG detached signature (.asc/.sig) for verifying the checksum file.

signing_key.description: GPG key URL or fingerprint for signature verification.

depth.description: Git clone depth (git adapter). Default 1 (shallow). 0 = full history.

binary.description: Binary name to check for. Used by git adapter's Check() to verify installation.

sudo_required.description: Whether the http method requires sudo for extraction/installation. Set to false when the tool is extracted to a user-writable path (e.g. ~/.local/bin).

whenCondition.title: When condition — platform applicability gate
whenCondition.description:
Condition that gates a method's applicability. The engine evaluates every non-empty field against system facts (AND semantics — all must match). If the condition doesn't match, this method is skipped and the next one is tried.

Each field accepts a list of values (OR semantics — any single match suffices). Comparison is case-insensitive. Libc uses prefix matching (e.g. "glibc" matches "glibc 2.35").

distro_family.description:
Match on resolved distro family (clan). Values: debian, arch, fedora, alpine, gentoo, void, suse, macos, freebsd, openbsd, netbsd, termux, android, nixos, solus, slackware, mageia, openmandriva, or unknown.

Example: ["arch"] matches Arch Linux, EndeavourOS, Manjaro, CachyOS.

distro_id.description: Match on exact distro ID (from /etc/os-release ID=). Case-insensitive. Example: ["ubuntu", "debian"] matches exactly those distros, not Mint or Pop!_OS.

arch.description: Match on target architecture (output of uname -m). Example: ["x86_64", "aarch64"] matches both AMD64 and ARM64 systems.

os.description: Match on operating system name (lowercase uname -s). Common values: linux, darwin, windows, freebsd, openbsd, netbsd. Example: ["linux"] matches any Linux.

kernel.description: Match on full kernel version string (uname -r). Exact match, case-insensitive. Example: ["6.7.0-arch", "6.8.0"] for kernel-specific packages.

libc.description: Match on C standard library. Uses prefix matching — "glibc" matches "glibc 2.35". Values the detector emits: glibc, musl, uclibc, freebsd-libc. Example: ["musl"] matches Alpine Linux.

init_system.description: Match on init system. Values: systemd, openrc, runit, sysvinit. Example: ["systemd"] matches distros using systemd.

is_wsl.description: Match on WSL (Windows Subsystem for Linux) environment. Set to true to restrict to WSL, false to exclude WSL. Omit to ignore.

is_container.description: Match on container environment. Set to true to restrict to containers (Docker, Podman, LXC), false to exclude. Omit to ignore.
